Name: Vael's Familiars - a FAUNA shop expansion for TotAG
Author: CodysOasis
Description:
[color=#fafafa][size=4]ABOUT[/size][/color]
There is something in the forest.
Something old, and watchful, and patient. Vael, Keeper of the Pack, has tended the Aether Glade for longer than anyone in Pelican Town can remember. They do not seek company. They do not ask for anything.
But the pack is theirs, and the pack is many, and if you are patient enough, persistent enough, and quiet enough...
They might share it with you.
[b]Vael's Familiars[/b] is a Tales of the Aether Glade expansion that adds a roster of magical Familiars from Vael's pack -- ancient creatures you can befriend, bond with, and call your own. This is not a story about power. It's a story about trust.


[size=4]UPDATE 1.1: [/size]
I reworked FAUNA! A lot! Which unfortunately came with casualties. 
If you were one of the 89 people who downloaded 1.0, familiars may get voided on transferring up to 1.1. I truly apologize and I swear I spent hours trying to figure out a good work around, but this is the cleanest option I could find. 
All other data (relationships, items, the den building) should all be safe. 

A moment of silence for the familiars lost in the update, they will be missed dearly.
[line]
[heading]FAMILIARS[/heading]
Vael's pack is your pack, if you earn that right.
[b][i]Familiars are magical creatures [/i][/b]-- not pets, not trinkets -- powered by the [b]FAUNA[/b] framework. They have their own Food and Attention needs that decay daily, individual gift tastes, and unique abilities that unlock as your Trust with them grows. Neglect them and they'll remember. Tend to them and they'll grow.
[b][i]Familiars[/i][/b] are purchased through Vael's shop in the Aether Glade, gating access behind your friendship with the Keeper of the Pack. The deeper that bond, the more of the pack opens to you.
[b][i]The Familiar Den[/i][/b]
Build this farm building through Robin's shop to house your familiars. Check their stats, feed them, and interact with them here each day.
[line]
[heading]THE PACK[/heading]
[b][i]Black Cat[/i][/b]
Aloof and a little snooty. They've clearly decided they're better than you. They're probably right. Keep showing up anyway, and somewhere at higher trust they'll quietly, grudgingly admit they don't mind you. Maybe they'll even bless you with a slow eye blink!
[i]Abilities: Luck buff while following. Gains a speed buff at higher trust.
[/i]
[b][i]Hound[/i][/b]
Loyal and diligent to the bone. They take their duties seriously and execute them with quiet pride. Earn enough trust and you'll catch glimpses of the goofy, playful dog underneath all that professionalism.
[i]Abilities: Attacks nearby monsters. Gains a passive attack buff at higher trust.[/i]
[b][i]Spirit Hound[/i][/b]
Everything the Hound is, with something more behind the eyes. They carry a faint, wordless connection to the moon; present at dusk, stronger past midnight. What they sense in that light, they don't say.
[i]Abilities: Attacks nearby monsters. Gains a passive attack buff at higher trust.
[/i]
[b][i]Watcher Crow[/i][/b]
Intensely curious and unsettlingly observant. They are always watching not just what's in front of them, but what others miss entirely. Resourceful, clever, and several steps ahead of everyone in the room.
[i]Abilities: Collects nearby forage automatically. Has an inventory to store what they find.
[/i]
[b][i]Otter[/i][/b]
Pure chaos energy in a sleek little body. Hyperactive, easily distracted, and absolutely delighted by everything. They have no off switch and no interest in finding one.
[i]Abilities: Assists with fishing. Has an inventory to store the catch.[/i]
[b][i]Moonlit Otter[/i][/b]
Just as playful and unhinged as any other otter, but threaded through with something magical. They tune themselves to the tides , and the way moonlight scatters across moving water. They shimmer a little at night.
[i]Abilities: Assists with fishing. Has an inventory to store the catch.[/i]
[b][i]Loonaloo Otter[/i][/b]
The same relentless energy, but pulled toward the deep. Themed around the abyssal sea and bioluminescence, they glow faintly in the dark, and seem drawn to depths that shouldn't exist this far from the ocean.
[i]Abilities: Assists with fishing. Has an inventory to store the catch.
[/i]
[b][i]Aether Squirrel[/i][/b]
Anxious, constantly moving, perpetually convinced something is about to happen. They are bound to the Aether Tree, the ancient mythos that roots all organic life, and feel every shift in its root network. Something is always shifting. They are always aware of it.
[i]Abilities: Harvests nearby mature crops automatically. Has an inventory to store what they collect.[/i]
[b][i]Ashen Squirrel[/i][/b]
Just as anxious and just as alert, but channeled into purpose. Themed around burned forests and what grows after, they fulfil the will of the Aether Tree by replanting in the ash, diligent and quietly devoted to restoration.
[i]Abilities: Harvests nearby mature crops automatically. Has an inventory to store what they collect.
[/i]
[b][i]Astral Ewe[/i][/b]
Calm and deeply comforting, like a warm light in a dark room. They are tied to the Astral Realm, the plane that holds the dreams and wishes of all living things. Their presence carries a gentle blessing. They say befriending one grants sweet dreams.
[i]Abilities: Interacts with nearby farm animals to boost their friendship.[/i]
[b][i]LullaLamb[/i][/b]
Serene in a way that feels almost contagious. Also tied to the Astral Realm, but where the Ewe blesses, the Lamb lulls -- drawing creatures toward rest, stillness, and the soft edge of sleep. They don't rush anything. Neither will you, around them.
[i]Abilities: Interacts with nearby farm animals to boost their friendship. [/i]
[line]
[heading]FEATURES[/heading]
[list]
[*]11 familiars across multiple species, each with unique abilities and personalities[/*]
[*]Familiar availability gated behind friendship with Vael -- the pack opens slowly[/*]
[*]Familiar Den farm building (via FAUNA) for housing and managing your familiars[/*]
[*]Food, Attention, Mood, and Trust stat system -- familiars respond to how you treat them[/*]
[/list][i]More coming soon![/i]
[line]
[heading]MIGRATING FROM VAEL'S FAMILIARS - AN NPC SHOP EXPANSION[/heading]
If you played the original mod, welcome back! This version is a full restructure -- same heart, new bones.
To migrate your save:
[list=1]
[*]Download the [b]Save Migration Tool[/b] file alongside Vael's Familiars[/*]
[*]Install it like any other mod -- drop it in your Mods folder[/*]
[*]Launch the game once. The tool will handle the migration automatically.[/*]
[*]Once done, you can remove the Save Migration Tool mod.[/*]
[/list]If you run into any issues, please report them on the Bugs tab.
[line]
[heading]REQUIREMENTS[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley (latest version)[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46494]FAUNA[/url][/b] [i](Familiar Allies Utility Network API)[/i][/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45040]Tales of the Aether Glade[/url][/b] [i](TotAG Core)[/i][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]COMPATIBILITY[/heading]
[list]
[*]Works alongside most NPC expansion mods[/*]
[*]Familiars are a distinct entity class (powered by FAUNA) -- mods targeting pets or trinkets specifically will not affect them[/*]
[*]Report conflicts on the Bugs tab[/*]
[/list][line]
